articles.title: From a Rockabilly Surprise to a Life-Changing Hit: The Wild History of World Cup Anthems
articles.summary: World Cup songs do more than get crowds cheering—they can break records and even spark real-life love stories. Shakira's 'Waka Waka' led her to meet her children's father. We ranked the official anthems, from forgotten gems to global bangers.

articles.title: We Pelted Robot Vacuums with Flour and Cereal to Find the True Cleaning Kings
articles.summary: Our stress test involved three floor types and a blizzard of crumbs. We found two standout robot vacuums: the feature-packed Roborock QV 35A and the surprisingly affordable Tapo RV30 Max Plus. One lifts its mop to save your rugs; the other brings premium mapping to a budget price.

articles.title: Overwatch's New Omnic Hero Shion Has a Human Face—and Fans Have Questions
articles.summary: Shion, the upcoming Omnic damage hero, rides a motorcycle into battle and dual-wields pistols. But her human-like face has reignited the 'same face syndrome' debate. Is it a lore hint about Omnic identity, or another push for skin sales?
